capabilityPolicy.constructors: Only exact argument-label sequences in the manifest are recognized for property inspection; unlisted overloads stay read-only and unsupported.
capabilityPolicy.componentCalls: One unambiguous local View definition; properties retain their call-site expressions and link to the definition.
capabilityPolicy.closureSlots: Only known content builders are traversed. Action closures are preserved as source and never evaluated by the authoring model.
capabilityPolicy.propertyWriters: Phase 2–3 subset writers are implemented in packages/swift-sema/src/design-controls.ts and enumerated in packages/shared/src/authoring-writers.ts. Each control carries source, scope and a recipe ID; commands validate project revision and ownership. Native/browser acceptance remains pending.
capabilityPolicy.unknownExpressions: Preserve source; do not infer editability from evaluated values.
capabilityPolicy.modifierOrder: Preserve each occurrence and its exact position, including repeated padding/background modifiers.

nativeReference.thresholdPolicy: Calibrate repeat-capture noise, compare corresponding content regions, and freeze thresholds only after real native evidence. Null is blocked, never zero or passing.
nativeReference.reason: Simulator runtime identity and regional image thresholds cannot be frozen until CoreSimulator execution and captures succeed. Existing references remain provisional.
